sample_unit: synthetic patients (open-weight cohort; closed-weight subset N=200)
unlisted_practices: Comparing locally deployable open-weight LLM pipelines with proprietary pipelines for equivalence
Comparing agentic LLM classification against deterministic execution of the same rubric
Validating LLM-generated severity phenotypes against algorithmic comparators and mortality/complication outcomes

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an agentic multi-LLM framework (MOSAIC) for disease severity phenotyping from EHR data on a synthetic cohort, without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
